channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Janet and Jeff started to feel like the city was squeezing them out. When Janet started to long to be back home in Nova Scotia, they decided to take a trip and smell the salt air. After only a few days of their vacation they realized it was time to move. Their house in the city quickly went up for sale and now they're looking for a new home where Janet can see and smell the ocean every day.
